Class ViewLessonDetail

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetail.ViewLessonDetail
public class ViewLessonDetail extends Object

Title: ViewLessonDetail Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based lesson detail page. It shows every attribute of one lesson (CS-3), read only, with Edit and Delete buttons for the lesson's contributor (CS-7, CS-8) that are disabled, with a line saying why, for anyone else (CS-9).

The lesson is shown on its own page rather than as a dialog over the list because the description and resolution can each be 2000 characters, which does not fit in a dialog, and because this page is where the editor returns to after a save, so the contributor sees the stored result and the identifier it was given.

The long fields are shown in read only text areas rather than labels so that long text scrolls instead of running off the page, and so the text can be selected and copied.

As in every supplied View, this class is a singleton.

  • Method Details

    • displayLessonDetail

      public static void displayLessonDetail(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: displayLessonDetail(Stage ps, User user, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: The single entry point from outside this package that displays one lesson. Every value is filled in from the lesson, and Edit and Delete are enabled only when the logged in user is the lesson's contributor (CS-9).

      Parameters:
      ps - the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and its methods
      user - the User for this GUI and its methods
      lesson - the lesson to show
